title: Oscar and the Smile
author: J. M. Winterbourne
blurb: Edmund Joubert, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must get the family out ahead of the count before the well refills.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
